changeSet.author: wms
changeSet.createProcedure: create view aur_vw_firm_order_exists (cari_kod, cari_unvan, cari_baglanti_tipi, cari_hareket_tipi, bolge_kodu, bolge_adi, sip_tip, sip_depo_no) as SELECT DISTINCT aed.cari_kod, aed.cari_unvan, aed.cari_baglanti_tipi, aed.cari_hareket_tipi, aed.bolge_kodu, aed.bolge_adi, aed.sip_tip, aed.sip_depo_no FROM aur_erp_data aed WHERE aed.cari_kod IS NOT NULL -- "siparisi var" = teslim edilmemis miktar kalmis satirlar AND coalesce(aed.sip_miktar, 0) > coalesce(aed.sip_teslim_miktar, 0);

changeSet.author: wms
changeSet.createProcedure: create view aur_vw_firm_order_detail (id, stokkodu, stokadi, siparismiktar, teslimmiktar, barkod, stokbirimi, siptip, depono, musterikod, caribaglantitipi) as SELECT aed.id, aed.sip_stok_kod AS stokkodu, aed.stok_adi AS stokadi, aed.sip_miktar AS siparismiktar, aed.sip_teslim_miktar AS teslimmiktar, aed.barkod, aed.stok_birimi AS stokbirimi, aed.sip_tip AS siptip, aed.sip_depo_no AS depono, aed.sip_musteri_kod AS musterikod, aed.cari_baglanti_tipi AS caribaglantitipi FROM aur_erp_data aed;

changeSet.author: wms
changeSet.createProcedure: create view aur_vw_firm_orderlist_bulk (id, stokkodu, stokadi, siparismiktar, teslimmiktar, barkod, stokbirimi, sipuid, orderno, orderdate, siptip, depono, musterikod, caribaglantitipi) as SELECT aed.id, aed.sip_stok_kod AS stokkodu, aed.stok_adi AS stokadi, aed.sip_miktar AS siparismiktar, aed.sip_teslim_miktar AS teslimmiktar, aed.barkod, aed.stok_birimi AS stokbirimi, aed.sip_guid AS sipuid, aed.sip_belge_no AS orderno, aed.sip_tarih AS orderdate, aed.sip_tip AS siptip, aed.sip_depo_no AS depono, aed.sip_musteri_kod AS musterikod, aed.cari_baglanti_tipi AS caribaglantitipi FROM aur_erp_data aed;
